text.autoconfig.bettermineshafts-fabric-: YUNG's Better Mineshafts
Main Settings
Spawn Rates & More
Ore Deposits
Minimum y-coordinate
The lowest the floor of a mineshaft can be.
Maximum y-coordinate
The highest the floor of a mineshaft can be.
Disable Vanilla Mineshafts
Whether or not vanilla mineshafts should be disabled.
Spawn Rates & More
Customize spawn rates for various mineshaft parts and decorations.
Ore Deposits
Configure ore deposit spawn chances.
MAKE SURE ALL THE VALUES ADD UP TO 100,
or things won't work the way you want them to!!
Lantern Spawn Rate
The spawn rate for lanterns in the main shaft.
Torch Spawn Rate
The spawn rate for torches in small shafts.
Workstation Spawn Rate
The spawn rate for workstation side rooms along the main shaft.
Workstation Cellar Spawn Rate
The spawn rate for workstation cellars below workstations along the main shaft.
Small Shaft Spawn Rate
The spawn rate for smaller tunnels that generate along the main shaft.
Cobweb Spawn Rate
The spawn rate for cobwebs.
Small Shaft Chest Minecart Spawn Rate
The spawn rate for minecarts holding chests in small shafts.
Main Shaft Chest Minecart Spawn Rate
The spawn rate for minecarts holding chests in the main shaft.
Small Shaft TNT Minecart Spawn Rate
The spawn rate for minecarts holding TNT in small shafts.
Main Shaft TNT  Minecart Spawn Rate
The spawn rate for minecarts holding TNT in the main shaft.
Abandoned Miners' Outpost Spawn Rate
Percent chance of an Abandoned Miners' Outpost to spawn
at the end of a small mineshaft tunnel.
Small Shaft Piece Chain Length
The number of "pieces" (e.g. straight, turn, etc) in a single small shaft.
This determines the overall size of small shafts.
Enable Ore Deposits
Cobble Spawn Chance (Empty deposit)
Percent chance of an ore deposit being cobblestone only.
Coal Spawn Chance
Percent chance of an ore deposit containing coal.
Iron Spawn Chance
Percent chance of an ore deposit containing iron.
Redstone Spawn Chance
Percent chance of an ore deposit containing redstone.
Gold Spawn Chance
Percent chance of an ore deposit containing gold.
Lapis Spawn Chance
Percent chance of an ore deposit containing lapis.
Emerald Spawn Chance
Percent chance of an ore deposit containing emerald.
Diamond Spawn Chance
Percent chance of an ore deposit containing diamond.
bettermineshafts.configuration.min_y.too: The lowest a mineshaft can spawn. Applies when a world loads.
bettermineshafts.configuration.max_y.too: The highest a mineshaft can spawn. Applies when a world loads.
bettermineshafts.configuration.lantern_r: The spawn rate for lanterns in the main shaft. Applies when a world loads.
bettermineshafts.configuration.torch_rat: The spawn rate for torches in small shafts. Applies when a world loads.
bettermineshafts.configuration.workstati: The spawn rate for workstation side rooms along the main shaft. Applies when a world loads.
The spawn rate for workstation cellars below workstations along the main shaft. Applies when a world loads.
bettermineshafts.configuration.small_sha: The spawn rate for smaller tunnels that generate along the main shaft. Applies when a world loads.
bettermineshafts.configuration.cobweb_ra: The spawn rate for cobwebs. Applies when a world loads.
bettermineshafts.configuration.small_sha: Small Shaft Chest Minecart Spawn Rate
The spawn rate for minecarts holding chests in small shafts. Applies when a world loads.
Small Shaft TNT Minecart Spawn Rate
The spawn rate for minecarts holding TNT in small shafts. Applies when a world loads.
bettermineshafts.configuration.main_shaf: Main Shaft Chest Minecart Spawn Rate
The spawn rate for minecarts holding chests in the main shaft. Applies when a world loads.
Main Shaft TNT Minecart Spawn Rate
The spawn rate for minecarts holding TNT in the main shaft. Applies when a world loads.
bettermineshafts.configuration.outpost_c: Percent chance of an Abandoned Miners' Outpost to spawn at the end of a small mineshaft tunnel. Applies when a world loads.
bettermineshafts.configuration.small_sha: The number of pieces (straight, turn, ladder, intersection and so on) in a single small shaft. Applies when a world loads.
bettermineshafts.configuration.ore_depos: Whether small shafts may end in ore deposits. Applies when a world loads.
bettermineshafts.configuration.cobble_ch: Chance of an ore deposit being cobblestone only. The eight chances should add up to 100. Applies when a world loads.
bettermineshafts.configuration.coal_chan: Chance of an ore deposit containing coal. Applies when a world loads.
bettermineshafts.configuration.iron_chan: Chance of an ore deposit containing iron. Applies when a world loads.
bettermineshafts.configuration.redstone_: Chance of an ore deposit containing redstone. Applies when a world loads.
bettermineshafts.configuration.gold_chan: Chance of an ore deposit containing gold. Applies when a world loads.
bettermineshafts.configuration.lapis_cha: Chance of an ore deposit containing lapis lazuli. Applies when a world loads.
bettermineshafts.configuration.emerald_c: Chance of an ore deposit containing emerald. Applies when a world loads.
bettermineshafts.configuration.diamond_c: Chance of an ore deposit containing diamond. Applies when a world loads.
